Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
Do you always retrieve the card/cost of a cancelled action or strike ( say
through, Change of Target et al ) or only when speicified in the card text?

Also what does "since your last turn" mean exactly? If I burn a minion during my
turn, can I daemonic possession it in the same turn?

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
Oh, and one other question, with a (S) Scorpion's Touch, does the affected

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"GreySeer" <grey...@golsyd.net.au> a écrit dans le message news:
9opcdc$7c8$1...@news.eisa.net.au...

> Do you always retrieve the card/cost of a cancelled action or strike ( say
> through, Change of Target et al ) or only when speicified in the card
text?

yes. you pay the cost of an action (like 2 blood for Dominate Kine or Burn
the edge for Enticement ;) ) when the action resolves. If the action is
blocked or cancelled, you don't pay. The blood you spent on modifiers is
lost cose it was paid when you played them though.

Watenda's ability works differently : the blood you spend on a card is lost
(but watenda has to pay this cost)

> Also what does "since your last turn" mean exactly? If I burn a minion
during my
> turn, can I daemonic possession it in the same turn?

it qualifies. Since your last turn = this turn and the previous turn

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"GreySeer" <grey...@golsyd.net.au> a écrit dans le message news:

9opdgg$90j$1...@news.eisa.net.au...

> Oh, and one other question, with a (S) Scorpion's Touch, does the affected
> minion burn a blood once only in it's next untap phase?

The card stays on the affected minion until someone removes it. So, yes, as
long as the card is on him, he loses one blood or life each untap phase.

reyda

>
> "GreySeer" <grey...@golsyd.net.au> a écrit dans le message news:

> > Do you always retrieve the card/cost of a cancelled action or strike ( say

> text?
>
> yes. you pay the cost of an action (like 2 blood for Dominate Kine or Burn
> the edge for Enticement ;) ) when the action resolves. If the action is
> blocked or cancelled, you don't pay. The blood you spent on modifiers is
> lost cose it was paid when you played them though.

You only retrieve costs paid when specified by card text.
As Reyda notes, however, the cost of an action is not paid until it is
successful (unblocked).

> Watenda's ability works differently : the blood you spend on a card is lost
> (but watenda has to pay this cost)
>
> > Also what does "since your last turn" mean exactly? If I burn a minion
> during my
> > turn, can I daemonic possession it in the same turn?
>
> it qualifies. Since your last turn = this turn and the previous turn

= "this turn and everyone's turn after your previous turn."
